key_insight: Detonation-spraying settings strongly tune the trade-off between dense, hard Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C coatings and their friction/wear performance.
engineering_relevance: The study provides practical process windows for restoring and strengthening machine parts with self-fluxing nickel-based coatings.
method: Changed inter-shot delay from 0 to 1 s
evidence_signal: Testing showed the lowest friction at 48% barrel filling and O/C = 1.026, while the best wear resistance occurred at O/C = 1.856 with 1 s delay, reducing specific wear rate to 0.000189 mm³/(N·m).
watch_item: Optimizing for low friction can increase wear, so process tuning must balance tribology against residual-stress-driven cracking and porosity.
paper_title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying
